name: Surena
summary: Iran's national humanoid program, run by the University of Tehran's Center for Advanced Systems and Technologies. From the simple Surena I (2008) the line has grown to Surena IV (2019) and the collaboration-focused Surena V, full-size bipeds with dozens of joints, force-controlled walking, vision and speech, developed largely from domestically sourced parts.
notable: Specs given here are for Surena IV; Surena V is ~1.63 m / 73 kg / 41 DOF
